name: MediSphere Diagnostics
description: MediSphere Diagnostics is a Bengaluru-based in-vitro diagnostics company that supplies clinical chemistry and immunoassay analyzers, point-of-care test kits, RT-PCR molecular diagnostics kits and a cloud Laboratory Information System to hospitals, lab chains and government health programmes.

profile.summary: MediSphere Diagnostics helps hospitals, diagnostic lab chains and public health systems run faster, more reliable laboratories. We combine fully automated clinical chemistry and immunoassay analyzers, rapid point-of-care kits and CE/CDSCO-approved RT-PCR kits with SphereLIS, a cloud laboratory information system, and offer everything on a reagent-rental model so customers pay per reportable test rather than committing capital upfront. Our field service network covers 180 Indian cities with a 6-hour response SLA in metros.
valueProps: Zero-capex reagent rental: pay per reportable test, analyzers placed free
Single vendor for chemistry, immunoassay, point-of-care, molecular and LIS
30–40% faster turnaround time with middleware auto-verification
Accreditation-ready QC, calibration and audit trails built into SphereLIS
6-hour on-site service response in metros, 24 hours in tier-2 cities
differentiators: Made-in-India analyzers and kits with local reagent manufacturing in Bengaluru
Cloud LIS with native home-collection, B2B and hub-and-spoke workflows
Proven government tender track record across three states
Uptime guarantee of 98% backed by service credits
Open-channel analyzers that also run third-party reagents where needed

products.name: SphereChem 800
products.description: Fully automated clinical chemistry analyzer processing up to 800 photometric tests per hour plus ISE, with 60 onboard reagent positions and closed-tube sampling.
products.priceNotes: Placed on reagent rental; outright purchase list price INR 38 lakh.

products.name: SphereIA 240
products.description: Chemiluminescence immunoassay analyzer running 240 tests per hour across thyroid, fertility, cardiac markers (hs-troponin, NT-proBNP), tumour markers and infectious disease panels.
products.priceNotes: Reagent rental from INR 95 per reportable TSH test at 3,000 tests/month.

products.name: SpherePOC Rapid Kits
products.description: Rapid lateral-flow and cartridge-based point-of-care kits for dengue, malaria, typhoid, HbA1c, CRP, troponin I and hepatitis, with a handheld reader that syncs results to SphereLIS.
products.priceNotes: Kits INR 60–450 per test; readers free above 1,000 tests/month.

products.name: SphereMDx RT-PCR Panels
products.description: RT-PCR kits for TB, hepatitis B/C viral load, HPV, respiratory viral panels and STI panels, validated on open real-time PCR platforms with automated extraction options.
products.priceNotes: INR 650–2,400 per reaction depending on panel; volume tiers for tenders.

products.name: SphereLIS Cloud
products.description: Cloud laboratory information system with barcode sample tracking, instrument middleware, auto-verification rules, NABL-ready QC dashboards, home-collection app integration and patient report delivery via WhatsApp and email.
products.priceNotes: Subscription per site per month; see Essentials/Professional/Enterprise plans.

products.name: Government Hub-and-Spoke Bundle
products.description: Tender-ready bundle for state health departments combining hub-lab analyzers, PHC point-of-care kits, SphereLIS state dashboard and operated-lab staffing on a per-test pricing model.
products.priceNotes: Per-test rates quoted per tender; floor margins defined in internal pricing policy.

plans.name: Reagent Rental Programme

features: Free analyzer placement, installation and training

plans.pricing: Essentials INR 18,000 per site per month (up to 300 samples/day); Professional INR 42,000 per site per month (up to 2,000 samples/day).

Instrument interfacing for up to 10 analyzers
Professional adds auto-verification and home-collection app integration

plans.name: SphereLIS Enterprise
plans.pricing: Custom annual contract for 10+ sites; typically INR 30,000–35,000 per site per month with multi-year discount.
features: HIS/EMR integration via HL7 and FHIR

policies.title: Service Level Agreement
policies.body: MediSphere commits to on-site engineer response within 6 hours in metro cities and 24 hours in tier-2 and tier-3 cities for breakdowns of installed analyzers. Instrument uptime of 98% per calendar quarter is guaranteed for analyzers under reagent rental; shortfalls are credited as free reagent. SphereLIS Cloud offers 99.5% monthly availability with 24x7 phone and WhatsApp support.

policies.title: Data Privacy & Patient Data Protection
policies.body: All patient data processed in SphereLIS Cloud is hosted in data centres located in the customer's country where required by law, encrypted in transit and at rest, and accessible only to authorised customer users. MediSphere acts as a data processor, does not sell or use patient data for marketing, and supports customer obligations under applicable data protection laws, including breach notification within 72 hours.

policies.title: Pricing & Discount Authority
policies.body: Sales representatives may offer up to 8% discount on list reagent-rental rates. Discounts of 8–15% require Regional Sales Manager approval; above 15% or any government tender bid requires approval from the Head of Sales and Finance. Per-test rates must not fall below the floor price defined for each test category, and analyzer placement requires a minimum committed volume of 2,500 tests per month for chemistry.

customSignals.name: Home Sample Collection Expansion
customSignals.description: A lab chain, telehealth platform or startup launches or scales home sample collection, adding cities, phlebotomists or collection centres.
customSignals.matchInstructions: Match when a healthcare company launches home sample collection or at-home testing, expands it to new cities, or hires phlebotomists or opens collection centres at scale. Higher volumes drive demand for analyzer capacity, point-of-care kits and a LIS integrated with booking apps. Do NOT match veterinary or pet testing, nurse home-care visits without sample collection, or one-off health camps.

customSignals.name: Lab Automation & Digitisation
customSignals.description: A hospital or lab plans lab automation, a new laboratory information system, middleware or digitisation to cut turnaround time.
customSignals.matchInstructions: Match when a hospital, lab chain or public health lab announces plans or RFPs for lab automation lines, a new or cloud laboratory information system, instrument middleware, auto-verification or digitisation of lab workflows. Do NOT match radiology-only PACS projects, generic hospital EMR rollouts without a lab component, or IT outsourcing unrelated to laboratories.
